run_gmock_doctor: pipe compiler error output into gmock_doctor.py via stdin to diagnose Google Mock usage problems
diagnose_gmock_errors: call Diagnose with a compiler error message string to get a list of plain English diagnoses
review_generic_diagnoser: review the _GenericDiagnoser factory function that creates pattern-matching diagnosers from regex and diagnosis pairs
review_diagnoser_list: review the _DIAGNOSERS list of 13 specialized diagnoser functions for common Google Mock compiler errors
summarize_find_all_matches: summarize the _FindAllMatches utility function that returns all regex matches in a given string
